title: ServerConfig
description: Response of GET /api/config on the ADMIN port: the operator's full view of this server's configuration, including block store statistics. The transfer port answers the same path with a much shorter document (client-config.schema.json) carrying only what a client acts on.

hashAlgorithm.description: Algorithm used for archive hashes and for the per block hashes in the framing.

maxBlockSize.description: The server's --max-block-size argument: the hard upper bound for any block on the wire. A client must reject a larger frame. Always >= blockSizeMax.

blockSizeMin.description: Lower bound the content defined chunker observes, except for the last block of a payload.

blockSizeAvg.description: Target average block size the chunker aims at. A power of two.

blockSizeMax.description: Largest block the chunker will actually emit. Derived from blockSizeAvg and clamped by maxBlockSize.

storedBlocks.description: Distinct blocks currently in the server's block store, across all versions.

storedBlockBytes.description: Total payload bytes in the block store. Smaller than the sum of all archive sizes because versions share blocks.

transportCompression.description: Whether this server will compress the block stream for a client that sends Accept-Encoding: gzip. Blocks carry decompressed content, so an uncompressed stream puts more bytes on the wire than the archive's own compressed growth.

transportCompressionLevel.description: The gzip level used, or 0 when compression is off. Level 1 is the default: measured at 78.9% of the original at 62 MB/s against level 6's 77.2% at 39 MB/s.

maxSevenZDecomposeSize.description: The server's --max-7z-size: the largest nested 7z container that is opened up instead of being carried as opaque blocks. Informational here; the authoritative value for any given version travels inside its blueprint, because the client has to decompose its local base under the same policy that produced the target's blueprint.
